article.headline: Hamilton rain washout forces Black Caps into desperate fight for series draw
article.summary: Heavy rain at Seddon Park abandoned the third ODI between New Zealand and India, leaving the hosts trailing 2-0 in the series.
article.body:
Not a single ball was bowled in Hamilton as persistent weather forced officials to abandon the third ODI of the series. The washout effectively ended New Zealand’s hopes of an ODI series victory against India, leaving the Black Caps unable to win the remaining two matches after already falling 2-0 behind following losses in Auckland and Wellington. The team now faces the prospect of their first home ODI series defeat since 2019.

This result is significant for the Black Caps, who have successfully defended their home turf by winning 11 consecutive ODI series over the last five years. For local fans who turned out for the sellout event, the abandonment denied any chance of a 40-overs-per-side contest. The loss of points and momentum comes at a difficult time as the squad prepares for upcoming test matches.

The challenge for New Zealand deepens as they enter games four and five without several key starters. Players including Tom Latham, Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Henry Nicholls, and Nathan Smith are set to depart the ODI group to begin preparations for the test series in Wellington. Additionally, the side faces setbacks with players like Lockie Ferguson withdrawn due to injury, requiring a roster shuffle that brings in reinforcements like Finn Allen and Nick Kelly.

With only two games remaining, New Zealand must secure wins at Bay Oval to avoid a series loss. Both upcoming fixtures will test the depth of the squad as they look to salvage a 2-2 draw.

article.headline: Bills Shore Up Secondary By Acquiring League-Leading Interceptor Amani Hooker From Titans
article.summary: The Buffalo Bills acquired veteran safety Amani Hooker from the Tennessee Titans at the NFL trade deadline in exchange for a second-round draft pick.
article.body:
Amani Hooker enters the Bills' defensive lineup as the NFL's current leader in interceptions for the 2026 season, having already recorded five picks this year. A former 2019 fourth-round draft selection, the 28-year-old safety brings significant durability to Buffalo, boasting 103 career appearances and 74 starts, along with over 5,200 snaps of professional experience. Throughout his career, he has accumulated 17 interceptions, 45 passes defensed, and five forced fumbles.

For the Buffalo Bills, this move addresses a glaring vacancy in the secondary as the team looks toward the remainder of the season and beyond. General manager Brandon Beane executed the trade at the deadline to stabilize a defensive unit that was actively scanning the safety pool for reinforcements. Because Hooker remains under contract through the 2028 season, the acquisition provides Buffalo with long-term security, offering a contrast to other recent league trades involving shorter-term contracts.

According to reports from NBC Sports, the transaction involves an exchange of draft capital where the Bills send a second-round selection to Tennessee in return for Hooker and a fifth-round pick. Buffalo Rumblings noted that Hooker’s base salary for the remainder of the current season sits at approximately $2 million, allowing the move to fit within the team's salary cap constraints. While Hooker will not turn 30 until June 2028, his experience as a starter since 2021 makes him a central piece for the current Bills defense.

article.headline: Nvidia Stock Plunges 10% Over CEO Jensen Huang Chinese Intelligence Affair Probe
article.summary: Nvidia’s board hired law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate CEO Jensen Huang following his admission of an affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.
article.body:
Nvidia’s market value is reeling as shares dropped 6% on Tuesday, compounding a 4% decline from Monday, after the board of directors launched an urgent probe into CEO Jensen Huang. The investigation follows Huang’s Sunday admission in an email to staff regarding his affair with Alice Huang, a woman identified in reports by The New York Times and the Financial Times as having ties to Chinese intelligence. The company’s board has retained former acting U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York Joon H. Kim and the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to determine if the executive's actions compromised sensitive company secrets or broader national security interests. 

This crisis presents significant risks for Nvidia, an essential supplier that powers nearly all major artificial intelligence models globally. Investors are increasingly wary that the scandal could force the departure of Huang, who has served as the central public face of the AI industry. Beyond internal leadership instability, the firm faces mounting pressure from politicians and critics regarding the sale of restricted AI chips to Chinese companies. 

Legal experts, including former deputy assistant attorney general John Yoo, have raised alarms regarding the national security implications of the relationship. Concerns center on whether the affair facilitated unauthorized technology transfers to Beijing, potentially bypassing existing semiconductor export controls. While Huang stated in his email to staff that he remains committed to his role at the company and emphasized his support for U.S. national security, the firm’s board is conducting what they described as a thorough and independent investigation. The outcome remains uncertain as the company navigates this period of public scrutiny and corporate turmoil.

article.headline: Jim Jordan Clinches House GOP Leader Spot Defeating Scalise By 33 Votes
article.summary: Jim Jordan secured the position of House GOP minority leader after defeating Steve Scalise in a closed-door secret ballot vote on Tuesday.
article.body:
Loud, sustained applause erupted in the hallway outside the meeting room as the official results confirmed Jordan's victory. The Ohio Republican claimed the leadership role by securing 106 votes against the 73 votes cast for Majority Leader Steve Scalise.

This leadership shift follows a period of major losses for Republicans in both state and federal races. With the party hungry for change, the election marks a new chapter for the House GOP as they transition into their minority status in Congress. Jordan is expected to serve as a primary defender for President Donald Trump.

According to Fox News Digital, the election took place on Tuesday during a closed-door session involving incumbent House Republicans and members-elect. The process featured a morning candidate forum where lawmakers questioned the contenders on topics including conference unity and internal leaks. Both candidates during this session emphasized their commitment to allowing individual representatives to vote according to the needs of their specific districts.

In a concurrent leadership decision, House Majority Whip Tom Emmer won the position of minority whip, defeating August Pfluger with a final tally of 103 to 76 votes.

article.headline: بدء امتحانات شهر نوفمبر لطلاب صفوف النقل بجميع المدارس 29 نوفمبر
article.summary: تُجري وزارة التربية والتعليم امتحانات شهر نوفمبر لصفوف النقل من الأول الابتدائي حتى الثاني الثانوي بدءاً من 29 نوفمبر وحتى 3 ديسمبر 2026.
article.body:
مع اقتراب نهاية شهر نوفمبر الحالي، تضع الإدارات التعليمية اللمسات الأخيرة استعداداً لانطلاق امتحانات الشهر لجميع طلاب صفوف النقل، حيث شددت وزارة التربية والتعليم والتعليم الفني على عدم وجود أي تأجيل أو تعديل في المواعيد المقررة. الاختبارات التي تبدأ رسمياً يوم 29 نوفمبر وتستمر حتى 3 ديسمبر 2026، تُعد المحطة الأخيرة من اختبارات الشهور للفصل الدراسي الأول، وتكتسب أهمية خاصة لكون درجاتها تضاف مباشرة إلى مجموع أعمال السنة الخاص بالطالب.

تعد هذه الامتحانات جزءاً محورياً في تقييم مستوى الطلاب وقياس نواتج التعلم خلال الفترة الدراسية المحددة، إذ تستهدف الإجراءات الوزارية تحقيق العدالة وتكافؤ الفرص بين جميع الطلاب في مختلف المحافظات. ويتولى موجه المادة في كل إدارة تعليمية مسؤولية إعداد ثلاثة نماذج امتحانية مختلفة لكل مادة، لضمان تنوع الأسئلة ومنع الغش داخل اللجان، وفقاً للمواصفات الفنية التي يحددها المركز القومي للامتحانات والتقويم التربوي.

يقتصر محتوى الامتحانات على الأجزاء التي درسها الطلاب فعلياً من المناهج الدراسية خلال شهر نوفمبر، وذلك وفق الخطة الزمنية المعتمدة من الوزارة، مما يعني أنها لا تغطي كامل منهج الفصل الدراسي الأول. كما أكدت الوزارة أن الأسئلة مستمدة من كتب التقييمات والكتاب المدرسي لجميع المراحل، مشددة على ضرورة حضور الطلاب، حيث سيواجه المتغيبون دون عذر طبي رسمي معتمد عقوبة فقدان درجات هذا الاختبار بالكامل دون فرصة للإعادة.

تأتي هذه الخطوة تمهيداً للامتحانات النهائية، حيث من المقرر أن يبدأ طلاب صفوف النقل أداء امتحانات الفصل الدراسي الأول للمواد الأساسية في 9 يناير 2027، بينما تُعقد امتحانات المواد غير المضافة للمجموع خلال شهر ديسمبر. وتتابع المديريات والإدارات التعليمية بانتظام تنفيذ هذه التعليمات لضمان سير العملية الامتحانية بانضباط وشفافية كاملة وفقاً للجداول التي ستعلنها كل مديرية في وقت لاحق.

पहाड़ों पर बर्फबारी और दिल्ली में कोहरे के आसार, जानें देशभर के मौसम का हाल
news.og_title: पहाड़ों पर बर्फबारी और दिल्ली में कोहरे के आसार, जानें देशभर के मौसम का हाल
news.og_desc: देशभर में मौसम का मिजाज तेजी से बदल रहा है। दक्षिण भारत के तमिलनाडु, पुडुचेरी, कराईकल, आंध्र प्रदेश, केरल और अंडमान-निकोबार द्वीप समूह में भारी बारिश और तेज हवाओं की संभावना है। वहीं, पूर्वी और पूर्वोत्तर भारत के कई राज्यों में गरज-चमक के साथ बौछारें पड़ सकती हैं। नए वेस्टर्न डिस्टर्बेंस के सक्रिय होने से हिमालयी क्षेत्रों जैसे कि उत्तराखंड, जम्मू-कश्मीर और हिमाचल प्रदेश में बारिश के साथ-साथ ऊंचे पहाड़ी इलाकों में बर्फबारी के पूरे आसार हैं। दूसरी ओर, राष्ट्रीय राजधानी दिल्ली में सुबह के समय कोहरा छाया रहेगा और दोपहर में गर्मी के साथ-साथ वायु प्रदूषण की स्थिति बेहद खराब बनी रह सकती है। मौसम विभाग ने लोगों को सतर्क रहने की सलाह दी है।
